{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check if any QA orders are marked as completed
qa_completed = df[qa_mask]['status']
print(f'QA orders status: {qa_completed.unique()}')

# Check if any QA orders are marked as converted
qa_converted = df[qa_mask]['converted']
print(f'QA orders converted: {qa_converted.unique()}')"}
